hindi: हे इन्द्र, पुकार सुनो, हानि मत पहुँचाओ; हम तुम्हारे धनों के दान में रहें। क्योंकि ये बल, धन की कामना करते हुए, बहती हुई नदियों के समान तुम्हें बढ़ाते हैं।
english: Hear the call, O Indra; do not do harm; may we be in your giving of goods. For these strengths, desiring goods, strengthen you, like rivers flowing.
notes: śrudhī: the long ī is the Vedic form of the imperative śrudhi. mā riṣaṇyaḥ: read as a prohibition with the injunctive of a denominative of √riṣ ('do not do harm, do not fail'); object not stated; uncertain. imā agrees with ūrjaḥ (feminine plural). The strengths are not identified (for instance hymns or offerings).
lines_deva: श्रु॒धी हव॑मिन्द्र॒ मा रि॑षण्य॒: स्याम॑ ते दा॒वने॒ वसू॑नाम्
इ॒मा हि त्वामूर्जो॑ व॒र्धय॑न्ति वसू॒यव॒: सिन्ध॑वो॒ न क्षर॑न्तः
lines_iast: śru̱dhī hava̭mindra̱ mā ri̭ṣaṇya̱: syāma̭ te dā̱vane̱ vasṷ̄nām
i̱mā hi tvāmūrjo̭ va̱rdhaya̭nti vasū̱yava̱: sindha̭vo̱ na kṣara̭ntaḥ

words.gram: m. acc. sg. pres. part. mid. √man
m. nom. sg. pf. part. mid. √vṛdh

hindi: हे इन्द्र, तुमने उन महतियों को छोड़ा, जिन्हें तुमने उमड़ाया, जो सर्प द्वारा रोकी गई थीं, हे शूर, उन बहुतों को। स्तोत्रों से बढ़ते हुए उसने अमर समझने वाले दास को भी चीर डाला।
english: You released the great ones, O Indra, which you made swell, held back by the serpent, O hero, the many. Strengthened by hymns, he split down the Dāsa, even one who thought himself immortal.
notes: The feminine plurals (mahīḥ, yāḥ, pariṣṭhitāḥ, pūrvīḥ) have no noun in the verse; they are left as 'the great ones, the many'. pūrvīḥ could also mean 'former'. The person changes from 'you' in pāda a to 'he' in pāda b (Indra is the subject throughout). avābhinat = ava abhinat 'split down'.
lines_deva: सृ॒जो म॒हीरि॑न्द्र॒ या अपि॑न्व॒: परि॑ष्ठिता॒ अहि॑ना शूर पू॒र्वीः
अम॑र्त्यं चिद् दा॒सं मन्य॑मान॒मवा॑भिनदु॒क्थैर्वा॑वृधा॒नः
lines_iast: sṛ̱jo ma̱hīri̭ndra̱ yā api̭nva̱: pari̭ṣṭhitā̱ ahi̭nā śūra pū̱rvīḥ
ama̭rtyaṃ cid dā̱saṃ manya̭māna̱mavā̭bhinadu̱kthairvā̭vṛdhā̱naḥ

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √mand

hindi: हे शूर, अब उन स्तोत्रों में जिनमें तुमने आनन्द लिया, हे इन्द्र, स्तोमों में और रुद्र-सम्बन्धियों में भी; ये तुम्हारे ही लिए हैं, जिनमें हर्षित होते हुए तुम हो; उज्ज्वलों के समान ये वायु की ओर बह चलती हैं।
english: Now in the hymns, O hero, in which you took delight, in the praises, O Indra, and in those of Rudra: these are for you alone, in which you rejoice; like bright ones they flow forth to Vāyu.
notes: The printed cākan tstomeṣu has a t before s after the final n: this is the euphonic t between n and s, not a separate word; not verified. cākan: read as an injunctive of √kan 'take delight'; uncertain. rudriyeṣu: 'of Rudra, belonging to Rudra'; the referent (hymns or Rudra's company) is not stated. The construction of pāda b is difficult; etāḥ and śubhrāḥ are taken as feminine plurals without a stated noun, and na as 'like'. The whole verse is tentative.
lines_deva: उ॒क्थेष्विन्नु शू॑र॒ येषु॑ चा॒कन् त्स्तोमे॑ष्विन्द्र रु॒द्रिये॑षु च
तुभ्येदे॒ता यासु॑ मन्दसा॒नः प्र वा॒यवे॑ सिस्रते॒ न शु॒भ्राः
lines_iast: u̱ktheṣvinnu śṷ̄ra̱ yeṣṷ cā̱kan tstomḙṣvindra ru̱driyḙṣu ca
tubhyede̱tā yāsṷ mandasā̱naḥ pra vā̱yavḙ sisrate̱ na śu̱bhrāḥ

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. caus. √vṛdh
m. nom. pl. pres. part. mid. √dhā
m. nom. sg. pf. part. mid. √vṛdh

hindi: अब तुम्हारे उज्ज्वल बल को बढ़ाते हुए, भुजाओं में उज्ज्वल वज्र को धारण करते हुए, हे इन्द्र, तुम उज्ज्वल, बढ़ते हुए, हमारे लिए सूर्य के साथ दास जनों को परास्त करो।
english: Now strengthening your bright might, placing the bright vajra in the arms, you, bright, O Indra, being strengthened, may overcome for us the Dāsa clans with the sun.
notes: sahyāḥ: read as a 2 sg. optative or precative of √sah 'may you overcome'; it could also be the gerundive sahyāḥ 'to be overcome', agreeing with viśaḥ. asme is 'for us' (dative or locative). The persons in pāda a (those who strengthen and place the vajra) are not stated. 'vajra' is kept as the name of the weapon (thunderbolt).
lines_deva: शु॒भ्रं नु ते॒ शुष्मं॑ व॒र्धय॑न्तः शु॒भ्रं वज्रं॑ बा॒ह्वोर्दधा॑नाः
शु॒भ्रस्त्वमि॑न्द्र वावृधा॒नो अ॒स्मे दासी॒र्विश॒: सूर्ये॑ण सह्याः
lines_iast: śu̱bhraṃ nu te̱ śuṣma̭ṃ va̱rdhaya̭ntaḥ śu̱bhraṃ vajra̭ṃ bā̱hvordadhā̭nāḥ
śu̱bhrastvami̭ndra vāvṛdhā̱no a̱sme dāsī̱rviśa̱: sūryḙṇa sahyāḥ

hindi: गुफा में रखे हुए, छिपे हुए, गुप्त, जलों में आवृत, मायावी, रहते हुए को; और जिसने जलों और द्युलोक को रोक रखा था, उस अहि को हे शूर, तुमने वीर कृत्यों से मारा।
english: Placed in concealment, hidden, concealed, enveloped in the waters, the wily one, dwelling; and him who had held fast the waters and the sky, you slew, the serpent, O hero, with heroic deeds.
notes: guhā: a form of guhā 'in a hiding-place, in concealment'; case uncertain. The accusatives of pāda a are taken to refer to the serpent (ahim) of pāda b. tastabhvāṃsam: 'having propped, held fast' (√stambh). vīrya: 'heroism, manly power'.
lines_deva: गुहा॑ हि॒तं गुह्यं॑ गू॒ळहम॒प्स्वपी॑वृतं मा॒यिनं॑ क्षि॒यन्त॑म्
उ॒तो अ॒पो द्यां त॑स्त॒भ्वांस॒मह॒न्नहिं॑ शूर वी॒र्ये॑ण
lines_iast: guhā̭ hi̱taṃ guhya̭ṃ gū̱ḻahama̱psvapī̭vṛtaṃ mā̱yina̭ṃ kṣi̱yanta̭m
u̱to a̱po dyāṃ ta̭sta̱bhvāṃsa̱maha̱nnahi̭ṃ śūra vī̱ryḙṇa

hindi: हे इन्द्र, अब मैं तुम्हारे प्राचीन महान् कर्मों की स्तुति करूँगा, और हम नए किए हुए कर्मों की स्तुति करेंगे। मैं भुजाओं में उत्सुक वज्र की स्तुति करूँगा; मैं दोनों भूरे घोड़ों की, सूर्य के दोनों केतुओं की, स्तुति करूँगा।
english: Now, O Indra, I shall praise your former great deeds, and we shall praise the new deeds that have been done. I shall praise the vajra, eager in the arms; I shall praise the two tawny horses, the two beacons of the sun.
notes: te indra is printed ta indra. kṛtāni: 'deeds, things done'. harī: Indra's two bay horses (the word itself means 'the two bays'). ketū: 'beacons, signs' (also 'banners'); the phrase sūryasya ketū is literal and its sense is not explained here.
lines_deva: स्तवा॒ नु त॑ इन्द्र पू॒र्व्या म॒हान्यु॒त स्त॑वाम॒ नूत॑ना कृ॒तानि॑
स्तवा॒ वज्रं॑ बा॒ह्वोरु॒शन्तं॒ स्तवा॒ हरी॒ सूर्य॑स्य के॒तू
lines_iast: stavā̱ nu ta̭ indra pū̱rvyā ma̱hānyu̱ta sta̭vāma̱ nūta̭nā kṛ̱tāni̭
stavā̱ vajra̭ṃ bā̱hvoru̱śanta̱ṃ stavā̱ harī̱ sūrya̭sya ke̱tū

words.gram: m. nom. du. pres. part. denom. √vāj

hindi: हे इन्द्र, अब तुम्हारे दोनों भूरे घोड़े, पुरस्कार की कामना करते हुए, घी टपकाती हुई ध्वनि कर चुके हैं। पृथ्वी समतल होकर फैल गई और चलने को उद्यत पर्वत भी ठहर गया।
english: Now, O Indra, your two tawny horses, eager for the prize, have uttered a sound dripping ghee. The earth spread out level, and the mountain, though about to move, came to rest.
notes: ghṛtaścutam svāram: 'a sound dripping ghee' is literal and the sense is not clear. The printed bhūmiraprathiṣṭā'raṃsta is read bhūmiḥ aprathiṣṭa araṃsta (a + a joined; the avagraha is the book's notation); the reading is uncertain. samanā: 'level, even' (adverbial); uncertain. araṃsta (√ram) is read 'came to rest, was still'. The subject of araṃsta is taken to be the mountain.
lines_deva: हरी॒ नु त॑ इन्द्र वा॒जय॑न्ता घृत॒श्चुतं॑ स्वा॒रम॑स्वार्ष्टाम्
वि स॑म॒ना भूमि॑रप्रथि॒ष्टाऽरं॑स्त॒ पर्व॑तश्चित् सरि॒ष्यन्
lines_iast: harī̱ nu ta̭ indra vā̱jaya̭ntā ghṛta̱ścuta̭ṃ svā̱rama̭svārṣṭām
vi sa̭ma̱nā bhūmi̭raprathi̱ṣṭā'ra̭ṃsta̱ parva̭taścit sari̱ṣyan

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. intens. mid. √vāś
m. nom. pl. pres. part. caus. √vṛdh

hindi: पर्वत नीचे बैठा दिया गया, उपेक्षा न करते हुए; माताओं के साथ गर्जन करता हुआ वह साथ-साथ चला। दूर, उस पार, वाणी को बढ़ाते हुए उन्होंने इन्द्र द्वारा भेजी गई धारा को फैला दिया।
english: The mountain was set down, not neglecting; bellowing with the mothers, he strode together. Far off, on the far shore, increasing the voice, they spread down the stream sent by Indra.
notes: The printed aprayucchan tsam has the euphonic t between n and s, not a separate word. The verse is difficult: the subject of akrān is not stated, 'the mothers' are not identified, and dhamanim ('stream, pipe, channel') is uncertain. 'sam akrān' is read 'strode together'. The translation is tentative.
lines_deva: नि पर्व॑तः सा॒द्यप्र॑युच्छ॒न् त्सं मा॒तृभि॑र्वावशा॒नो अ॑क्रान्
दू॒रे पा॒रे वाणीं॑ व॒र्धय॑न्त॒ इन्द्रे॑षितां ध॒मनिं॑ पप्रथ॒न् नि
lines_iast: ni parva̭taḥ sā̱dyapra̭yuccha̱n tsaṃ mā̱tṛbhi̭rvāvaśā̱no a̭krān
dū̱re pā̱re vāṇī̭ṃ va̱rdhaya̭nta̱ indrḙṣitāṃ dha̱mani̭ṃ papratha̱n ni

f. nom. du. pres. part. mid. √bhī

hindi: महान् इन्द्र ने नदी पर पड़े हुए मायावी वृत्र को बाहर फेंक दिया। गरजते हुए इस वृषभ के वज्र से डरकर दोनों लोक काँप उठे।
english: Indra, the great, hurled out Vṛtra, the wily, lying on the river. The two worlds, frightened, trembled at the vajra of this roaring bull.
notes: The printed mahāṃ is read mahān (nominative, with Indra). asphuran niḥ: the form asphuran (a plural-looking ending with a singular subject) is uncertain; read 'hurled out'. sindhum āśayānam: 'lying on the river' is uncertain; sindhum could also be taken as an adjective-like object. rodasī: 'the two worlds' (Heaven and Earth in the later reading, not stated here). kanikradataḥ vṛṣṇaḥ asya both qualify the owner of the vajra.
lines_deva: इन्द्रो॑ म॒हां सिन्धु॑मा॒शया॑नं माया॒विनं॑ वृ॒त्रम॑स्फुर॒न्निः
अरे॑जेतां॒ रोद॑सी भिया॒ने कनि॑क्रदतो॒ वृष्णो॑ अस्य॒ वज्रा॑त्
lines_iast: indro̭ ma̱hāṃ sindhṷmā̱śayā̭naṃ māyā̱vina̭ṃ vṛ̱trama̭sphura̱nniḥ
arḙjetā̱ṃ roda̭sī bhiyā̱ne kani̭kradato̱ vṛṣṇo̭ asya̱ vajrā̭t

hindi: इस वृषभ का वज्र गरजा, जब मनुष्य ने अमानुष को भस्म कर डाला होता। उसने मायावी दानव की मायाओं को नीचे गिरा दिया, निचोड़े हुए को पीकर।
english: The vajra of this bull roared when the human would burn down the non-human. Having drunk of the pressed, he made the wiles of the wily Dānava fall down.
notes: Pāda a is very uncertain: nijūrvāt is a rare verb form, and the relation of mānuṣaḥ and amānuṣam to the story is not stated. vajro 'mānuṣam = vajraḥ amānuṣam. The printed papivān tsutasya has the euphonic t between n and s. sutasya: 'of the pressed (drink)'; the noun is not stated. dānava: a being of the Danu kind; kept as 'Dānava'.
lines_deva: अरो॑रवी॒द् वृष्णो॑ अस्य॒ वज्रो ऽमा॑नुषं॒ यन्मानु॑षो नि॒जूर्वा॑त्
नि मा॒यिनो॑ दान॒वस्य॑ मा॒या अपा॑दयत् पपि॒वान् त्सु॒तस्य॑
lines_iast: aro̭ravī̱d vṛṣṇo̭ asya̱ vajro 'mā̭nuṣa̱ṃ yanmānṷṣo ni̱jūrvā̭t
ni mā̱yino̭ dāna̱vasya̭ mā̱yā apā̭dayat papi̱vān tsu̱tasya̭

hindi: हे शूर इन्द्र, सोम पियो, पियो; हर्ष देने वाले निचोड़े हुए तुम्हें प्रसन्न करें। तुम्हारे दोनों कुक्षियों को भरते हुए वे बढ़ाएँ; इस प्रकार निचोड़ा हुआ पौर इन्द्र की सहायता कर चुका है।
english: Drink, drink indeed, O Indra, hero, the Soma; let the exhilarating pressed ones exhilarate you. Filling your two bellies, let them strengthen thus; the pressed paura has helped Indra.
notes: The printed pibāpibed is read pibā pibā id (ā + i giving e). The second pāda is uncertain: pauraḥ is left untranslated as 'paura'; āva is read as a perfect or aorist of √av 'help'; the object of vardhayantu is not stated; itthā 'thus, truly'.
lines_deva: पिबा॑पि॒बेदि॑न्द्र शूर॒ सोमं॒ मन्द॑न्तु त्वा म॒न्दिन॑: सु॒तास॑:
पृ॒णन्त॑स्ते कु॒क्षी व॑र्धयन्त्वि॒त्था सु॒तः पौ॒र इन्द्र॑माव
lines_iast: pibā̭pi̱bedi̭ndra śūra̱ soma̱ṃ manda̭ntu tvā ma̱ndina̭: su̱tāsa̭:
pṛ̱ṇanta̭ste ku̱kṣī va̭rdhayantvi̱tthā su̱taḥ pau̱ra indra̭māva

hindi: हे इन्द्र, हम तुममें ही स्थित हो गए हैं; प्रेरित होकर, ऋत के अनुसार सेवा करते हुए हम धी को प्राप्त करें। सहायता चाहते हुए हम प्रशस्ति धारण करें; तुम्हारे धन के दान में हम तुरन्त रहें।
english: In you, O Indra, we have indeed become inspired ones; may we win thought, serving according to order. Desiring help, may we hold praise; at once may we be in your giving of wealth.
notes: tve api abhūma: 'we have become in you' (or 'we have become yours'); the exact sense is uncertain. ṛtayā: taken as 'rightly, in accordance with ṛta'; uncertain. dhīmahi: optative of √dhā 'may we hold, may we take'. viprāḥ: 'inspired, wise'.
lines_deva: त्वे इ॒न्द्राप्य॑भूम॒ विप्रा॒ धियं॑ वनेम ऋत॒या सप॑न्तः
अ॒व॒स्यवो॑ धीमहि॒ प्रश॑स्तिं स॒द्यस्ते॑ रा॒यो दा॒वने॑ स्याम
lines_iast: tve i̱ndrāpya̭bhūma̱ viprā̱ dhiya̭ṃ vanema ṛta̱yā sapa̭ntaḥ
a̱va̱syavo̭ dhīmahi̱ praśa̭stiṃ sa̱dyastḙ rā̱yo dā̱vanḙ syāma

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. caus. √vṛdh

hindi: हे इन्द्र, हम तुम्हारे हों, जो तुम्हारी सहायता से, सहायता चाहते हुए, बल को बढ़ाते हैं। जिस अत्यन्त बलवान् की हमने कामना की है, हे देव, उस वीरों से युक्त धन को तुम हमें दो।
english: May we be yours, those, O Indra, who by your help, desiring help, strengthen vigour. The most mighty wealth which we have desired, O god, you give to us, rich in heroes.
notes: The repeated te forms are read: first 'yours', then 'those', then 'your'; the construction is uncertain. rāsi is a subjunctive or injunctive and is taken as a request, 'give'. The wealth that is 'most mighty' is the object of the relative yam; the exact link of śuṣmintamam with rayim is read as apposition. cākanāma: from √kan 'be pleased, desire'.
lines_deva: स्याम॒ ते त॑ इन्द्र॒ ये त॑ ऊ॒ती अ॑व॒स्यव॒ ऊर्जं॑ व॒र्धय॑न्तः
शु॒ष्मिन्त॑मं॒ यं चा॒कना॑म देवा॒ऽस्मे र॒यिं रा॑सि वी॒रव॑न्तम्
lines_iast: syāma̱ te ta̭ indra̱ ye ta̭ ū̱tī a̭va̱syava̱ ūrja̭ṃ va̱rdhaya̭ntaḥ
śu̱ṣminta̭ma̱ṃ yaṃ cā̱kanā̭ma devā̱'sme ra̱yiṃ rā̭si vī̱rava̭ntam

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. mid. √mand

hindi: तुम निवास दो, तुम हमें मित्र दो, हे इन्द्र, तुम हमें मरुतों का समूह दो। जो एकमत हैं और हर्षित हैं, वे वायुगण आगे के नेतृत्व की रक्षा करते हैं।
english: You give a dwelling, you give us a friend, you give us, O Indra, the host of the Maruts. Those who are united and rejoicing, the Vāyus, protect the leadership.
notes: rāsi: injunctive or subjunctive of √rā; rendered as the plain present 'you give'. mitram: 'friend' (also the name Mitra); read as a common noun here. vāyavaḥ: nominative plural of Vāyu, 'the Vāyus'; the reading of pra vāyavaḥ pānti is uncertain, and the reference of sajoṣasaḥ ye ca mandasānāḥ is not clear. mārutam: 'belonging to the Maruts'.
lines_deva: रासि॒ क्षयं॒ रासि॑ मि॒त्रम॒स्मे रासि॒ शर्ध॑ इन्द्र॒ मारु॑तं नः
स॒जोष॑सो॒ ये च॑ मन्दसा॒नाः प्र वा॒यव॑: पा॒न्त्यग्र॑णीतिम्
lines_iast: rāsi̱ kṣaya̱ṃ rāsi̭ mi̱trama̱sme rāsi̱ śardha̭ indra̱ mārṷtaṃ naḥ
sa̱joṣa̭so̱ ye ca̭ mandasā̱nāḥ pra vā̱yava̭: pā̱ntyagra̭ṇītim

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √mand

hindi: वे अब आनन्द लें, जिनमें हर्षित होकर तृप्ति से सोम पियो, दृढ़ता से, हे इन्द्र। हे विजेता, हमें युद्धों में भली-भाँति तुमने बढ़ाया; द्युलोक को महान् मन्त्रों से बढ़ाया।
english: Let them enjoy indeed, now, in whom, rejoicing, drink the Soma to satisfaction, firmly, O Indra. Us, well, in battles, O overcomer — you strengthened the sky with great chants.
notes: The printed asmān tsu has the euphonic t between n and s. The verse is very uncertain: drahyat (read 'firmly') and tṛpat ('to satisfaction') are unclear forms; the division pṛtsu ā tarutra avardhayaḥ and the object of the second pāda are uncertain; asmān has no clear verb in the sentence. The relative yeṣu has no stated antecedent.
lines_deva: व्यन्त्विन्नु येषु॑ मन्दसा॒नस्तृ॒पत् सोमं॑ पाहि द्र॒ह्यदि॑न्द्र
अ॒स्मान् त्सु पृ॒त्स्वा त॑रु॒त्राऽव॑र्धयो॒ द्यां बृ॒हद्भि॑र॒र्कैः
lines_iast: vyantvinnu yeṣṷ mandasā̱nastṛ̱pat soma̭ṃ pāhi dra̱hyadi̭ndra
a̱smān tsu pṛ̱tsvā ta̭ru̱trā'va̭rdhayo̱ dyāṃ bṛ̱hadbhi̭ra̱rkaiḥ

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. mid. √stṛ

hindi: वे महान्, जो तुम्हारे, हे विजेता, स्तोत्रों से अथवा अनुग्रह की कामना करें; बर्हि बिछाते हुए, घर सहित, तुमसे रक्षित, हे इन्द्र, वे ही पुरस्कार तक पहुँचे हैं।
english: The great ones indeed, now, who, O overcomer, may seek your favour with hymns; spreading the barhis, with a homestead, helped by you, O Indra, they have come to the prize.
notes: The first token bṛ̱hanta̱ is read bṛhantaḥ (visarga dropped before i). bṛhantaḥ is a plural participle-like form, 'great ones', and who is meant is not stated. āvivāsān is read as a subjunctive 'may they seek'; uncertain. pastyāvat is read as 'with a homestead' (adverb); the sense is uncertain. The translation is tentative.
lines_deva: बृ॒हन्त॒ इन्नु ये ते॑ तरुत्रो॒क्थेभि॑र्वा सु॒म्नमा॒विवा॑सान्
स्तृ॒णा॒नासो॑ ब॒र्हिः प॒स्त्या॑व॒त्त्वोता॒ इदि॑न्द्र॒ वाज॑मग्मन्
lines_iast: bṛ̱hanta̱ innu ye tḙ tarutro̱kthebhi̭rvā su̱mnamā̱vivā̭sān
stṛ̱ṇā̱nāso̭ ba̱rhiḥ pa̱styā̭va̱ttvotā̱ idi̭ndra̱ vāja̭magman

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √mand
m. nom. sg. pres. part. intens. pra-√dhū
m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √prī

hindi: हे शूर, अब बलवानों में हर्षित होकर त्रिकद्रुकों में सोम पियो, हे इन्द्र। दाढ़ियों में हिलाते हुए, प्रसन्न होकर दोनों भूरे घोड़ों के साथ निचोड़े हुए (सोम) के पान के लिए आओ।
english: In the mighty ones now, O hero, rejoicing in the Trikadrukas, drink the Soma, O Indra. Shaking, in the beards, delighted, come with the two tawny horses to the drinking of the pressed.
notes: trikadrukeṣu: plural of trikadruka, a name (of a Soma-related rite); kept as a name. pradodhuvat śmaśruṣu: 'shaking in the beards' is literal and the sense is unclear (shaking what is not stated); uncertain. ugreṣu: 'in the mighty'; the noun is not stated. sutasya: the pressed (drink).
lines_deva: उ॒ग्रेष्विन्नु शू॑र मन्दसा॒नस्त्रिक॑द्रुकेषु पाहि॒ सोम॑मिन्द्र
प्र॒दोधु॑व॒च्छ्मश्रु॑षु प्रीणा॒नो या॒हि हरि॑भ्यां सु॒तस्य॑ पी॒तिम्
lines_iast: u̱greṣvinnu śṷ̄ra mandasā̱nastrika̭drukeṣu pāhi̱ soma̭mindra
pra̱dodhṷva̱cchmaśrṷṣu prīṇā̱no yā̱hi hari̭bhyāṃ su̱tasya̭ pī̱tim

hindi: हे शूर, उस बल को धारण करो जिससे तुमने वृत्र, दानु और औरणवाभ को चीर डाला। तुमने आर्य के लिए ज्योति को खोला; हे इन्द्र, दस्यु बाईं ओर नीचे बैठा दिया गया।
english: Take hold of the strength, O hero, by which you split down Vṛtra, Dānu, Aurṇavābha. You uncovered the light for the Ārya; the Dasyu was set down on the left, O Indra.
notes: dhiṣva: read as an imperative of √dhā 'take hold of'; uncertain ('show' is possible). dānum aurṇavābham: two names, read as further objects of avābhinat with vṛtram; kept as names. The words ārya and dasyu are kept as such. savyataḥ 'on the left' is adverbial.
lines_deva: धि॒ष्वा शव॑: शूर॒ येन॑ वृ॒त्रम॒वाभि॑न॒द् दानु॑मौर्णवा॒भम्
अपा॑वृणो॒र्ज्योति॒रार्या॑य॒ नि स॑व्य॒तः सा॑दि॒ दस्यु॑रिन्द्र
lines_iast: dhi̱ṣvā śava̭: śūra̱ yena̭ vṛ̱trama̱vābhi̭na̱d dānṷmaurṇavā̱bham
apā̭vṛṇo̱rjyoti̱rāryā̭ya̱ ni sa̭vya̱taḥ sā̭di̱ dasyṷrindra

hindi: हम, जो तुम्हारी सहायताओं से सब प्रतिद्वन्द्वियों को पार करते हुए आर्य के साथ दस्युओं को जीत लें। हमारे लिए उस बहुरूप त्वाष्ट्र को तुमने वश में किया, मित्रता के कारण त्रित के लिए।
english: May we win, who by your aids, overcoming all rivals, with the Ārya, the Dasyus. For us you subdued that Tvāṣṭra, the many-formed, for Trita, out of friendship.
notes: The construction of pāda a (sanema ... āryeṇa dasyūn) is uncertain; 'with the Ārya' could instead be 'by the Ārya way'. tvāṣṭram: 'the Tvāṣṭra' (a name, 'belonging to Tvaṣṭṛ'); kept as a name. arandhayaḥ: 'you subdued, delivered up' (causative of √randh); uncertain. sākhyasya tritāya: 'for Trita, of friendship' is read 'for Trita, out of friendship'; uncertain.
lines_deva: सने॑म॒ ये त॑ ऊ॒तिभि॒स्तर॑न्तो॒ विश्वा॒: स्पृध॒ आर्ये॑ण॒ दस्यू॑न्
अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ तत् त्वा॒ष्ट्रं वि॒श्वरू॑प॒मर॑न्धयः सा॒ख्यस्य॑ त्रि॒ताय॑
lines_iast: sanḙma̱ ye ta̭ ū̱tibhi̱stara̭nto̱ viśvā̱: spṛdha̱ āryḙṇa̱ dasyṷ̄n
a̱smabhya̱ṃ tat tvā̱ṣṭraṃ vi̱śvarṷ̄pa̱mara̭ndhayaḥ sā̱khyasya̭ tri̱tāya̭

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. mid. √su
m. nom. sg. pf. part. mid. √vṛdh

hindi: इस निचोड़े जाते हुए, हर्ष देने वाले के, त्रित के, बढ़ते हुए उसने अर्बुद को नीचे फेंका। उसने सूर्य के समान चक्र को घुमाया; अङ्गिरसों के साथ इन्द्र ने वल को चीर डाला।
english: Of this one being pressed, the exhilarating, of Trita, growing strong, he threw down Arbuda. He rolled, like the sun a wheel,; Indra, with the Aṅgirases, split Vala.
notes: The genitives asya suvānasya mandinaḥ tritasya are read as qualifying a drink or the one who presses; the exact relation is uncertain. astaḥ: the ending -aḥ is that of a second person, while the sentence is in the third person; read 'he threw'; uncertain. Arbuda and Vala are names of foes. avartayat has no stated object; 'it' is not in the Sanskrit. aṅgirasvān: 'accompanied by the Aṅgirases'.
lines_deva: अ॒स्य सु॑वा॒नस्य॑ म॒न्दिन॑स्त्रि॒तस्य॒ न्यर्बु॑दं वावृधा॒नो अ॑स्तः
अव॑र्तय॒त् सूर्यो॒ न च॒क्रं भि॒नद् व॒लमिन्द्रो॒ अङ्गि॑रस्वान्
lines_iast: a̱sya sṷvā̱nasya̭ ma̱ndina̭stri̱tasya̱ nyarbṷdaṃ vāvṛdhā̱no a̭staḥ
ava̭rtaya̱t sūryo̱ na ca̱kraṃ bhi̱nad va̱lamindro̱ aṅgi̭rasvān

hindi: हे इन्द्र, अब तुम्हारी वह उदार दक्षिणा गायक के लिए इच्छा के अनुसार फल दे।
english: Now may that bountiful gift of yours, O Indra, yield for the singer according to choice.
notes: Single-line unit. duhīyat: 'may it be milked, may it yield' (optative of √duh); prati varam read 'according to the choice'. dakṣiṇā: 'gift' (the sacrificial fee).
lines_deva: नू॒नं सा ते॒ प्रति॒ वरं॑ जरि॒त्रे दु॑ही॒यदि॑न्द्र॒ दक्षि॑णा म॒घोनी॑
lines_iast: nū̱naṃ sā te̱ prati̱ vara̭ṃ jari̱tre dṷhī̱yadi̭ndra̱ dakṣi̭ṇā ma̱ghonī̭

hindi: स्तोताओं की सहायता करो; भग हमें लाँघकर न जला दे। हम उत्तम वीरों से युक्त होकर यज्ञ में महान् रूप से बोलें।
english: Help the praisers; may Bhaga not burn past us. May we, rich in heroes, speak greatly in the rite.
notes: Single-line unit. The printed śikṣā is śikṣa (2 sg. imperative) with a lengthened final vowel. māti dhak bhago no is uncertain: it is read mā ati dhak bhagaḥ naḥ, 'may Bhaga not burn past us'; the sense of dhak here (√dah 'burn') and whether bhaga is the name Bhaga or 'fortune, share' is not certain. bṛhat is read adverbially 'greatly'. This is the refrain verse of the hymn.
lines_deva: शिक्षा॑ स्तो॒तृभ्यो॒ माति॑ ध॒ग्भगो॑ नो बृ॒हद् व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
lines_iast: śikṣā̭ sto̱tṛbhyo̱ māti̭ dha̱gbhago̭ no bṛ̱had va̭dema vi̱dathḙ su̱vīrā̭:
